jīvitindriya:
[Jīvita+indriya]  CL=10 'It is called Jīvitindriya because it exercises control over life (Jīvite indaṭṭhaṃ karotīti jīvitindriyaṃ).[Reference: Saṃ.Ṭha.3.269].
 Life (Jīvita) is that by which associated phenomena live. It is called Indriya because it exercises control in the characteristic of maintaining. Jīvitindriya is life itself as a controlling faculty. (Jīvantitena taṃ sampayuttakā dhammāti jīvitaṃ. Anupālanalakkhaṇe indaṭṭhaṃ kāretīti indriyaṃ, jīvitameva indriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ) [References: Abhi.Ṭha.1.167, Mahāni.Ṭha.128, (Abhi.Ṭha.1.193, Abhi.Ṭha.2.118, Paṭisaṃ.Ṭha.1.80). Also see Vibhāvanī.198.]
Jīvitindriya is the phenomenon that sovereignly maintains the co-arising mental and physical phenomena. There are two types of Jīvitindriya:
(a) Nāma-jīvitindriya: mental life-force, Jīvitindriya cetasika (mental factor)
(b) Rūpa-jīvitindriya: physical life-force, Jīvita-rūpa (material life-faculty)
